exercises.title: 6. Pratique: Time expressions — when, after, once

items.prompt: Once the buyer ___, the bank releases the documents.
items.hintAfterError: Depois de 'once', use o presente — e 'the buyer' pede -s.

items.prompt: After we ___ the goods, we send the documents to our bank.
items.hintAfterError: Sujeito 'we' e ação de rotina: presente simples, sem -s.

items.prompt: When the draft ___, the buyer must decide.
The seller gets paid after the collecting bank ___ the funds.
Once both banks ___, the deal is complete.
items.hintAfterError: Depois de 'once' não se usa 'will'; 'both banks' é plural.
